an10.48:2.1: Vevaṇṇiyamhi ajjhūpagato ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ.
an10.48:3.1: Parapaṭibaddhā me jīvikā ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ.
an10.48:4.1: Añño me ākappo karaṇīyo ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ.
an10.48:5.1: Kacci nu kho me attā sīlato na upavadatī ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ.
an10.48:6.1: Kacci nu kho maṃ anuvicca viññū sabrahmacārī sīlato na upavadantī ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ.
an10.48:7.1: Sabbehi me piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ.
an10.48:9.1: yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā, tassa dāyādo bhavissāmī ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ.
an10.48:10.1: Kathambhūtassa me rattindivā vītipatantī ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ.
an10.48:11.1: Kacci no kho 'haṃ suññāgāre abhiramāmī ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ.
an10.48:12.1: Atthi nu kho me uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanaviseso adhigato, so 'haṃ pacchime kāle sabrahmacārīhi puṭṭho na maṅku bhavissāmī ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ.
an10.48:13.1: Ime kho bhikkhave dasa dhammā pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbā ti. 1.
